g.text: Single causal self-attention head (16-dimensional learned position embeddings plus a value embedding; queries and keys learned, values = raw samples)
trained with Adam for 4 000 steps on random noisy two-harmonic signals (noise s.d. 0.30). The model was told nothing about the period.
